name: Dear Music, Thanks
tagline: A simple, retro-style music player for your phone
description:
Dear Music, Thanks (dmt) is a local music player with a text-based, retro computer terminal look and feel. If you like a simple, no-frills style over flashy modern designs, this player brings that old-school charm to your music.

It plays the songs you already have on your phone, wrapped in a distinctive, minimal interface unlike most other music apps.
